** QZ is not affiliated with or endorsed by any subscription service or maker of exercise equipment. **

Have you got a bike (echelon, flywheel, proform, i-console yesoul, decathlon, domyos, keiser, ...) or a Domyos (Decathlon) / Horizon / Proform  treadmill and you want to join to zwift? This app allows you to give a second life to your machine!

Also ellipticals and rowers machinery are supported now!

Simply connect your smartphone to the treadmill/bike and zwift/peloton/fulgaz/rouvy will recognize it!

Also this app allow you to use HealthKit to read your heart rate direct from your Apple Watch or any Heart Rate Bluetooth Belt. This metric will also be saved in your workout!

Compatible machineries:
- all the Echelon bikes (please check the firmware compatibility https://robertoviola.cloud/2025/07/22/how-i-built-qz-and-how-echelon-is-now-breaking-it/ )
- all the Domyos bikes
- all the Domyos treadmills
- all the Domyos elliptical machinery
- Smart Row Rower
- Echelon Rower (please check the firmware compatibility https://robertoviola.cloud/2025/07/22/how-i-built-qz-and-how-echelon-is-now-breaking-it/ )
- Concept Rower 2
- Yesoul S3 (M3 is currently on testing, if you have one, contact me)
- Sportstech bikes
- Inspire bikes
- Schwinn IC4 and Bowflex C6
- Toorx bikes and spinbikes
- Fassi treadmills
- all the Proform bikes without a tablet builtin
- Proform treadmills
- Flywheel bike (the calibration tool is here https://ptx2.net/apps/flytest/ )
- JK Fitness treadmill
- Toorx treadmills
- Sole elliptical
- Chrono bike
- NPECable
- and much more! ask me by email about the compatibility

results.releaseNotes:
New Equipment Support

Added support for 50+ new devices and protocols, including: Ultrasport F-Bike Pro, Kingsmith X21, Xplova Noza One, Keep Bike, Echelon Row 7s, Magee T600 ECO Smart Trainer, SmartRow V3, LifeSmart TM55, Volava, CARE SportsPlus rower, TOPUTURE TP6 and TEB, ProForm 105 CST, Sperax RM02, WaterRower USB, Van Rysel RCR, Freebeat Fit via USB/UART, MOK Fitness S10 Ultra, OpenBikeControl via UDP/mDNS, MRK-S36C ERG control, Adidas Horizon incline support.

New Features

Apple Watch rowing distance and total calories now written to HealthKit  
Heart rate from another QZ instance can be written to Apple Health on iPad  
Configurable Live Activity metrics on iOS  
Upload workouts directly from Workout History  
Grade-adjusted pace tile for treadmill running  
Heart rate zones and live speed/incline/heart charts for treadmills  
Treadmill auto-adjust speed by target power and force-running activity setting  
Custom gear resistance table for Virtual Shifting  
Cadence gain/offset applied to Apple Watch cadence; speed derived from cadence on Fake Treadmill  
Resistance +/- controls added to floating UI  
Custom watt tables for CSC and SmartBike resistance  
Garmin Lap Workouts, cadence targets, and secondary step targets  
Post-workout RPE/Feel popup saved to FIT files  
FIT files enriched with target zones, training effect, and session statistics  
Estimated watts from pace for WDK rowers and stroke-length calculation  
Zwift Click v1 and v2 simultaneous support  
Multilanguage Web Views and persistent workout editor device type  
HealthFit Android override, Xiaomi content helper, and Echelon Unlock for Peloton on iOS

Bug Fixes

Fixed HR PID boundary handling, race conditions, and stuck single-gear programs  
Fixed division-by-zero crashes, 10x calorie reporting, Apple Silicon startup crashes, OAuth secrets in logs, and doubled iOS Health cadence  
Fixed workout history imperial distance, editor key handling, and Carbon TLX disconnections  
Improved FTMS/Sole fallback and M3i iOS workout stability  
Fixed FS treadmill incline limits/override and ApexBike metrics parsing  
Fixed iOS search layout and Zwift Click one-direction handling  
Fixed Garmin workout visibility, special-character login, and workout/CORE synchronization  
Fixed FTMS elliptical, CARE/SportsPlus rower, Toputure TEB5, Nautilus B628, and MRK-S36C handling  
Fixed treadmill live charts, Adidas incline mapping, and Zwift Ride gear defaults  
Fixed FIT sport selection and missing preview inclination  
Deleted FIT files are now removed with their workouts; invalid Health Connect HRV samples are ignored  
Fixed WaterRower iOS build integration, Android/FitPro packaging, UnsatisfiedLinkError, and keyboard shortcuts  
Improved Freebeat telemetry/serial handling and V-BLE-R FTMS rower detection  
Fixed Wahoo KICKR RUN commands, speed display, and rapid-press accumulation  
MOK Fitness S10 Ultra now computes power from resistance and is correctly marked as non-ERG; fixed its setting count
